configuration: Upstream P2 plasma-beach problem (200 cells, 5 ns, SI units): a DG five-moment electron fluid driven by an applied current against a density ramp, coupled to the Maxwell field.
observable: the final electron five-moment frame, the final field frame and the complete field-energy history
variant: ic/variant/value.txt changes J0 from 1.0e-12 to 1.0000000000000004e-12, exactly two upward binary64 ULP.
altbuild: run.sh altbuild runs the nominal inputs on the same pinned source compiled strict-IEEE with the same gcc (-O2, no -ffast-math, -ffp-contract=off, no -march=native: the build-ieee/ tree of the oracle image); a correct port compiled without fast-math or FMA contraction is exactly such a build, so its distance from the default -O3 -ffast-math -march=native build is the floor a candidate must be allowed.

files.timestamps: matched on the recorded physical time within time_tolerance_fraction of the window; a non-finite or out-of-order time axis on either side fails the file

evidence.floor_how: measured by selfcheck on 2026-09-07: run.sh altbuild (same source, gcc -O2 strict IEEE: no -ffast-math, -ffp-contract=off, no -march=native (build-ieee/)) against run.sh nominal, graded with the check's own validate.py: all graded values within bound

altbuild.what: same source, gcc -O2 strict IEEE: no -ffast-math, -ffp-contract=off, no -march=native (build-ieee/)

warrant: The graded histories and frames follow the DG five-moment fluid species with an applied current source coupled to the DG Maxwell solver, the fluid-field coupling of the vlasov app. In `rt_dg_5m_mom_beach_p2.c`, `J0` (line 77) is the amplitude of the applied current; the two-ULP variant therefore moves every graded value at the level of the arithmetic, while a wrong applied-current source, a wrong fluid-Maxwell coupling or a wrong five-moment flux changes them at order one. The bound atol=1e-08, rtol=1e-08 was set on 2026-09-06 from the calibration selfcheck on the x86 worker 136.114.2.6 (1 cpu, 4 GB, Docker): the two-ULP variant used at most 2.4e-4 of it and the strict-IEEE altbuild at most 4.5e-3 (worst files `field.gkyl` and `field.gkyl`), a headroom of about 223x over the larger legitimate perturbation, while the faults named above move the graded values at order one.
